notes.title: Halloween with Veronica

[h1]One location, two characters, interactive dialog and sexual foreplay leading to hot sex scene where you control the action. [/h1]

BUILD HER PASSION
Depending on your choices made during the conversation with Veronica you may put her into sexy mood or... end this evening with your wife angry at you.

INTERACTIVE SEX SCENES
Select your favorite sex positions, camera angles and speed of animation. Experience POV to take a look at kinky details from character perspective.

DRESSING ROOM
